high_level_description: This image depicts a cozy and well-decorated living room. The room features a wooden furniture set that includes two armchairs and a sofa, all with light-colored cushions. The armchairs have patterned throw pillows, while the sofa has a solid orange pillow and a patterned one. The furniture is arranged around a low, square wooden coffee table placed on a light-colored area rug. The walls are painted in a light neutral tone, and there is a large framed artwork hanging above the armchairs.
